steps.content: The wind howls like blades atop the mountain cliff. Shen Wanchou and Ji Guining stand at the precipice, their figures sealing off the narrow ground. But below, they see only an endless sea of clouds, no sign of their quarry.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Hidden here? Clever. But this spirit-guiding jade of mine is no bauble. If it can't sniff out a codex, it can certainly track two warm bodies.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Young Master Shen, flaunt any louder, and they might just drag you down with them out of desperation.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Even a fake phoenix dares to scold me? For the alliance's sake, I'll let it slide. You have a better idea, then?

The Princess points, her fingertip tracing the air toward the footprints. They are sharp and clear in the snow, a deliberate trail leading straight to the old plum tree at the cliff's edge. The tracks are too obvious; they mean only one thing: a trap.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Young friend, restrain yourself. It's not too late. You're no true villain. Why stake your future on that manor master, she who sets deadly snares and stains her hands with blood?
You lean back against the old plum tree, standing on the very edge of the cliff. The footprints are indeed a decoy to make them suspicious and keep them exactly where you want them.

"Beneath the plum tree's roots is a hollow. When wind passes through, it wails like a mourner, and its resonance can shatter one's internal force... but the effect requires three people positioned in a triangle." Jichuan's instruction echoes in your mind. You calculate the timing, waiting for the right moment.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, young hero, the road ends here. Let's settle this once and for all.

options: How do you want to settle this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Settle what? I don't recall owing you. Or have you simply decided everything in Northwild is yours, and now my life as well?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm just some ordinary nobody without a shred of martial arts skill, trying to make a quick profit from the chaos. That's all. I don't know any manor master, and I only met Shuang'er a few days ago. So please, take pity on a poor fool and let me scurry off?
As you speak these words, your shoulder shifts back in what appears to be an unconscious lean.
The movement is immediately detected. Shen Wanchou crouches low and advances half a step toward your left, while Ji Guining adjusts her position accordingly to maintain their coordinated containment.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Bold words for someone looking for an exit. Fine, here's my family's gold token. With it, you can draw from any Shen bank in Northwild. Just show yourself and hand over Jichuan. Profit with no risk. What say you?

options: That's too much for a nobody like me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's great! I've been thinking it's time I struck it rich. How about you toss that token over first? Let me see if it's real.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hard to tell if you're after me giving up Jichuan, or just using me as bait to smoke her out. Either way, I'm not taking blood money.
As though she expects you to be the type who rejects the carrot and opts for the stick, Ji Guining displays no signs of anger.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Gold is dust, in the end. ${PlayerName}, you cannot shield her, nor that codex, the root of all this blood. Give it to me. I swear by the Ji name: this strife ends. You walk free, unburdened.
Their presence sharpens, but the third pressure has yet to make itself known.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Young Master Shen's gold, Lady Ji's vow of innocence... Back and forth, offering deals tainted and hollow. I can't play your righteous game. I'd only fumble it and end up like Jiewubei and the rest.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: That's their misfortune, their folly! But you... you still have a path. You still can choose survival.
The two have clearly lost their temper; their combined presence cuts off every possible escape route around you. But they are also moving closer, straight into the formation you planned.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Survival? I chose this morning, when you came for me. I won't be part of your rot.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Gold is gold. Power is power. Coin knows no right or wrong, and strength asks no leave. Since you're too ungrateful to see reason...

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Lady Ji, I hear your pipa can draw blood with enchanting notes? Once we've bound this one, I'd love a performance. Having the fool dangle upside down outside the manor gates could be a fine warning.
Just as Shen Wanchou begins to unfurl his folding fan, laughter rings out, arriving fashionably late.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: That codex is a curse. You two have years yet. Don't squander them. Hand it over, and this old man vows: your bodies intact, your graves serene. A kindness, truly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Right now!

The moment the shout leaves your lips, a chorus of deep creaks echoes from the plum tree's roots, as if something slumbering beneath the earth stirs awake. Ancient vines clinging to the rock face snap taut, and the currents of air above the cliff, disturbed by these sudden obstacles, compress and accelerate into chaos.
A visible, spiraling vortex of violent wind materializes, completely engulfing the three figures who now stand exactly at the triangle's focal points!

Fierce winds crash down, sending robes and hair into a wild dance, while deep resonant tones from the plum tree's hollow roots thrum through the gale. The air thickens around them like mountain stone; their internal force stalls, and they find themselves utterly immobilized.

In the blink of an eye, the formation is sealed. The winds of heaven and earth, channeled through the ancient tree, hold the three firmly in place. An ethereal woman's voice, impossibly clear, cuts through the howling gale and the vortex's thunderous roar, reaching each ear with perfect clarity.
Shen Wanchou.

Last year, on the third day of the twelfth month, at River Luo's ferry crossing. The Shen family sought glory through disaster relief, yet substituted moldy grain for fresh supplies. An escort guard, Zhao Qian, discovered the truth.

That night, the Zhao family of seven perished. So did a pair of traveling singers, a father and daughter, who happened to be staying at the inn and overheard your silencing. Nine souls in total. All of them, tragically, "slipped" and drowned in the river.
When their bodies were recovered, the little girl's hand still clutched fragments of gold-painted peacock patterns torn from your fan.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Who are you?! Stop this charade and show yourself!
He bellows the demand, writhing desperately to break the formation's hold, yet with every thrash, its grip only tightens further.
Ji Guining. Tell me, does that fallen dynasty's blood you claim still serve you well?
You cloak yourself in "Eastian legitimacy," all the while building your own faction and betraying the state. How many who paved your path to ambition... have quietly "vanished" over the years?

That devoted musician of yours... did she truly die of illness? Or was it because she knew too much, so you served her tea yourself and watched as she bled from every orifice, dying in voiceless agony?

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: My grievances are mine to settle. It is none of your concern!
The crushing force sends cracks spiderwebbing across her wheelchair, yet the obstinate Princess refuses to bow her head.
Yin Yansheng!
Do you still remember how many living souls you stripped to the bone, drained of marrow, their very essence extracted for your vile concoctions?

Seventy-three souls from Beihe Village. You claimed plague took them, but you imprisoned them as test subjects, poisoning them with every toxin until they withered away! And the herb-gatherers from Nanling, a brother and a sister. You lured them in and refined them alive into a batch of Yin-Yang Harmony Pills!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: A descendant of those wretches? No... wait. You're that little apprentice who escaped all those years ago?!
His voice turns shrill, his withered fingers bristling with poison needles, though he has no idea where to aim them.
I am no one. I merely seized the chance to peel back your masks and see the rot festering beneath.

I gave you a chance. Using the codex, using this manor, I set this final trial. I wanted to see if this martial world, which preaches heroism for cultivation and recognition, held even a shred of benevolence.
But you... All I see in you is greed, suspicion, betrayal, and murder. You failed to seize your final chance to prove your worth. The trial is over.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: You... wh-who in the hell are you?!
This is nothing but a simple misdirection. You were deceived once at the banquet, and you fell for it again?

Beneath the ancient plum tree at the cliff's edge, the stillness of fallen petals and deep snow shatters as they erupt skyward. In an instant, blossoms and snow surge upward in a reverse torrent, a fierce dragon-like whirlwind of white and crimson that pierces the clouds.
Red petals dance in the air; shattered stones scatter. As the great wind column fades and the snow dust settles, a figure in white stands silent in the calm.
[Transformation Sequence - Animated]

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Jichuan, Master of Northsnow Manor.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: This body carries the Jiang bloodline, and with it, divine martial arts. I claim the north snow as my bones, the winter plum as my soul, to cleanse this corruption and purify Northwild.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Since you sailed here with greed as your vessel and sin as your oars... today, I shall make my body the scales and your lives the weights. Let us measure exactly how heavy this blood debt has become!

As her words fall, the wind and snow suddenly intensify. The white robes flutter as her staff sweeps through the air. Vital energy surges like a dragon, carving the first pure snow across Northwild's sky.
[End]
